METADATA.TITLE: {appName}: value bets and arbs priced against the sharp line
METADATA.DESCRIPTION: Value bets and arbs from soft bookmakers, priced against the sharp fair line, with a public record.

THEME.TITLE: Theme
THEME.FONT_CUSTOM_PLACEHOLDER: Family name or Google Fonts link
THEME.FONT_CUSTOM_HINT: Any free Google font. Loaded from Google when you use it.
THEME.FONT_CUSTOM_INVALID: Use a Google font family name, letters and numbers only.

GROUP.SURFACE_HINT: The page, cards, menus and the sidebar panel.
GROUP.TEXT_HINT: Text on each of those surfaces.
GROUP.CONTROL_HINT: Buttons, chips, inputs, borders and focus rings.
GROUP.STATUS_HINT: Error, success, warning and info colours.
GROUP.SIDEBAR_HINT: Active item, hover and border inside the sidebar.

FOOTER.DISCLAIMER: Fair odds come from Pinnacle with the margin removed. Check every price at the bookmaker before betting. Bet only what you can afford to lose.

APPEARANCE.LABEL: Appearance
APPEARANCE.TITLE: Appearance
APPEARANCE.DESCRIPTION: Choose colors, fonts and shape for OpenEV.
APPEARANCE.HEADING: Appearance
APPEARANCE.SUBHEADING: Saved in this browser. Changes apply right away.

NOT_FOUND.HEADING: This page does not exist
NOT_FOUND.BODY: The link may be broken, or the bet or game is gone. Value bets disappear once the price moves or the game starts.

COMMON.UNREACHABLE_TITLE: The odds engine is not reachable
COMMON.UNREACHABLE_BODY: No prices can be loaded right now. Try again in a minute.

CONFIDENCE.HINT_LOW: Thin sharp market, fair price less certain
CONFIDENCE.HINT_CHECK: EV too high to trust, likely a stale price

OVERVIEW.LABEL: OpenEV preview
OVERVIEW.HEADING: Where the bookmakers are wrong right now
OVERVIEW.SUBHEADING: Prices from {books} bookmakers compared live with Pinnacle, the sharpest market, after removing its margin. Every alert goes into a public record with the closing line next to it, losers included.
OVERVIEW.TOP_EMPTY: Nothing above low confidence right now.

VALUE_BETS.LABEL: Positive EV
VALUE_BETS.HEADING: Value bets
VALUE_BETS.SUBHEADING: A bet shows up when a bookmaker pays more than the fair odds, which come from Pinnacle with its margin removed. Click a bet to see every book on that market, how the fair price was built and how the price moved.
VALUE_BETS.EMPTY: No value right now with these filters. Prices update every few seconds.
VALUE_BETS.NOTE_FAIR: Fair odds use the power devig of Pinnacle. The safe EV uses the least favourable of four methods, so it is the cautious number.
VALUE_BETS.NOTE_CONFIDENCE: Confidence follows Pinnacle's maximum stake on the market: the more money it accepts, the more the fair price can be trusted.
VALUE_BETS.NOTE_STAKE: Stake is quarter Kelly on a bankroll of 1000. Sign in to use your own bankroll and Kelly fraction. A price not reconfirmed within five minutes drops off the board.
VALUE_BETS.NOTE_STAKE_USER: Stake is {fraction} Kelly on your bankroll of {bankroll}, from your settings, after exchange commission. A price not reconfirmed within five minutes drops off the board.

BET.LABEL: Value bet
BET.GONE_TITLE: This price is no longer value
BET.GONE_BODY: The bookmaker moved, the fair line moved, or the game started. Value bets live only while the price beats the fair odds.
BET.TITLE: {bet} at {book}
BET.SUMMARY: {market} in {home} v {away}. {book} pays {odds} where the fair price is {fair}, a {chance} chance.
BET.DEVIG_TITLE: How the fair price is built
BET.METHOD_POWER_NOTE: Used for the headline EV. Takes more margin off long shots, as books do.
BET.METHOD_MULT_NOTE: Scales every outcome by the same factor.
BET.METHOD_ADD_NOTE: Removes the same amount from every outcome.
BET.METHOD_WORST_NOTE: The least favourable of the others for this bet. The safe EV.
BET.DEVIG_NOTE: Pinnacle prices this market with a {margin} margin and takes up to {stake} on it. Pinnacle was last seen {sharpSeen}, {book} {bookSeen}.
BET.ELSEWHERE_EMPTY: No other book prices this outcome.
BET.BEFORE_PRICE: Check the price at {book} is still {odds} or better.
BET.BEFORE_FAIR: Below {fair} the bet has no edge. Skip it.
BET.BEFORE_ROUND: Round the stake to a normal number. Odd amounts get accounts flagged.
BET.BEFORE_MIX: Mix in normal bets so the account does not look like it only takes value.
BET.FEE_COMMISSION: {book} keeps {commission} commission on net winnings, so every EV here uses the net odds of {net} instead of {odds}.
BET.FEE_TAKER: {book} charges a taker fee of {fee} times the price times one minus the price, so every EV here uses the net odds of {net} instead of {odds}.

ARBS.LABEL: Sure bets
ARBS.HEADING: Arbitrage
ARBS.SUBHEADING: Back every outcome at the book paying the most and the return is the same whatever happens. Stakes below split {total} so every outcome pays out the same. Arbs close fast: confirm every leg before placing the first one.
ARBS.EMPTY: No arbitrage right now. Soft books rarely disagree by enough at the same time; they show up most around team news and line moves.

GAMES.LABEL: Odds screen
GAMES.HEADING: Games
GAMES.SUBHEADING: Every game with a sharp price, by kickoff. Open a game to compare every bookmaker on every market against the fair line.
GAMES.COVERAGE: {books, plural, one {# book} other {# books}}, {markets, plural, one {# market} other {# markets}}

GAME.GONE_BODY: It has started or no book prices it any more.
GAME.SUBHEADING: Green prices beat the fair line. Hover a price to see its EV and when it was last confirmed. Pinnacle is shown in amber.

PROOF.LABEL: Public record
PROOF.HEADING: Every alert, next to the closing line
PROOF.SUBHEADING: Each bet that crosses +2% EV is written down the moment it is found, with the price and the fair odds at that moment. Nothing is removed afterwards. At kickoff the last Pinnacle fair price becomes the closing line. Beating the close is the best evidence an edge was real, long before results settle it.
PROOF.CLV_HINT: Alert odds against the closing fair odds

BOOKS.LABEL: Coverage
BOOKS.HEADING: Bookmakers
BOOKS.SUBHEADING: Every source we read, how much it prices right now and when we last confirmed it. A price we cannot reconfirm within five minutes is dropped, so nothing here is older than that.
BOOKS.MATCHED_HINT: Games we could pair with a Pinnacle game
BOOKS.GAP_HINT: Median difference in implied chance from Pinnacle on the same outcome

TOOLS.LABEL: Tools
TOOLS.HEADING: Calculators
TOOLS.SUBHEADING: The same maths the engine runs, for checking a price by hand.
TOOLS.EV_NOTE: Your price against the fair price, with a quarter Kelly stake.
TOOLS.DEVIG_NOTE: Enter every outcome of one market (leave the third empty for two way).
TOOLS.ARB_NOTE: Best odds for every outcome, split so each one returns the same.
TOOLS.CONVERT_NOTE: Decimal odds to the other formats and the implied chance.

TRACKER.LABEL: Your bets
TRACKER.HEADING: Bet tracker
TRACKER.SUBHEADING: Every bet you placed, its profit and how it did against the closing line. Beating the close is what shows an edge long before results do.
TRACKER.KPI_CLV_HINT: Your odds against the closing fair odds
TRACKER.KPI_BEAT_HINT: Share of the {closed} bets with a closing line
TRACKER.CHART_EMPTY: The chart starts with your first settled bet.
TRACKER.DELETE_BODY: It disappears from your tracker and every total. This cannot be undone.
TRACKER.PAYOUT_HINT: Leave empty to use stake times odds. Fill it in for a cash out or a partial result.
TRACKER.BETS_EMPTY: No bets here yet. Track one from a value bet or add it by hand.
TRACKER.ADD_HINT: For a bet you placed without the board. Add the fair odds if you know them to get its EV.
TRACKER.LINE_HINT: From the home team's side, for example -0.5.

ACCOUNT.LABEL: Account
ACCOUNT.WHY: An account keeps your bet tracker, staking settings and account health in one place. The board itself stays free to view.
ACCOUNT.SIGN_IN_HINT: With the email and password you registered.
ACCOUNT.REGISTER_HINT: Only an email and a password. No bookmaker details needed.
ACCOUNT.PROMPT_BODY: Track your bets, see your profit against the closing line and keep an eye on how bookmakers see your accounts.

ERRORS.SIGNED_OUT: Your session ended. Sign in again.
ERRORS.NOT_FOUND: This is gone. A value bet disappears once the price moves or the game starts.
ERRORS.TAKEN: This email is already registered. Sign in instead.
ERRORS.PASSWORD_LENGTH: The password needs at least 8 characters.
ERRORS.UNREACHABLE: The server is not reachable right now. Try again in a minute.
ERRORS.INVALID: Some values are not valid. Check the odds, the stake and the other fields.

TRACK.SIGN_IN_HINT: Sign in to track this bet
TRACK.TITLE: Track this bet
TRACK.ODDS_HINT: Change it if the bookmaker gave you a different price.
TRACK.STAKE_HINT: Your Kelly stake at these odds is {stake}, rounded to a whole number.

HEALTH.WHY_BODY: Value betting only pays while your accounts stay open. Bookmakers limit accounts that look like they only bet when the price is wrong. This page reads your tracked bets the way a trader would and tells you, book by book, what stands out.
HEALTH.TIP_MIX: Mix in ordinary bets, such as popular games and accumulators.
HEALTH.TIP_ROUND: Stake round amounts like 10, 25 or 50, never 23.47.
HEALTH.TIP_SPREAD: Spread your bets over several bookmakers instead of hammering one.
HEALTH.TIP_TIMING: Avoid betting the second a line opens or on obscure markets only.
HEALTH.TIP_WITHDRAW: Withdraw now and then and keep the account looking like a normal punter's.
HEALTH.EMPTY: Track a few bets first. The check needs at least 5 bets at a bookmaker.
HEALTH.VALUE_SHARE_HINT: Share of bets tracked from a value bet or placed above the fair price
HEALTH.ROUND_SHARE_HINT: Share of stakes that are a whole multiple of 5
HEALTH.LOW_LIQUIDITY_HINT: Share of bets on markets where Pinnacle took less than 1,000
HEALTH.TOO_FEW: Fewer than 5 bets here, too early to judge.
HEALTH.ALL_CLEAR: Nothing stands out at this bookmaker.

WARN.ALL_VALUE_BETS: Almost every bet here is a value bet.
WARN.ALL_VALUE_BETS_FIX: Bookmakers profile accounts that only take mispriced lines. Place some ordinary bets on popular games too.
WARN.NEVER_ROUND_FIX: Amounts like 23.47 look like a staking formula. Round to 5 or 10.
WARN.LOW_LIQUIDITY: Most bets are on thin markets.
WARN.LOW_LIQUIDITY_FIX: Books watch winners closest on low limit markets. Favour bigger leagues and main markets.
WARN.BEATS_CLOSE: You beat the closing line on most bets.
WARN.BEATS_CLOSE_FIX: That is the main signal books limit on. Good for your edge, so protect the account with the other habits above.

SETTINGS.LABEL: Account
SETTINGS.HEADING: Settings
SETTINGS.SUBHEADING: Signed in as {email}. These settings shape the stakes on the board and in your tracker.
SETTINGS.SUBHEADING_SIGNED_OUT: Sign in to set your bankroll, Kelly fraction, currency and bookmakers.
SETTINGS.STAKING_HINT: Stakes on the board are this share of the Kelly stake on this bankroll, rounded to whole numbers when you track a bet.
SETTINGS.KELLY_HINT: Now {fraction} of the full Kelly stake. Quarter Kelly is a safe start; full Kelly swings hard.
SETTINGS.BOOKS_HINT: The books you have accounts at. The value bet board gets a My books filter for them.
